After downloading a supported region, Sugarglider calculates routes, displays regional maps, analyzes elevation and exports GPX on the device without requiring an internet connection.

The region must cover your plan and its required data must be installed and verified. There is no uncovered-area routing fallback. D+/D− are terrain estimates, not surveyed measurements. Routes do not guarantee navigation, trail access or current conditions.

Downloading, updating and checking regional files requires internet access. The static host receives connection metadata such as your IP address and requested files. Optional online address search sends the text you submit to IGN Géoplateforme; it is separate from local planning and is unavailable without a connection.

With location permission, the app shows your private foreground position and can center or follow the map. With a previous permission grant, this can resume when you reopen the planner. Manual planning remains available without location permission. This release has no enabled social, outing or live-location publication and no configurable sharing server.

Android WebView and platform services can communicate when the phone is connected. Tests observed requests to content-autofill.googleapis.com and other traffic whose source remains unknown. The encrypted request contents were not established; we cannot confirm or exclude personal information in those requests. Offline planning does not mean these services are silent.

Regional data and preferences are stored locally. Use region removal controls to remove a region, or Android app storage controls to remove app data. GPX export uses the destination you choose in the Android document picker; that provider may sync its copy. Removing the app does not remove exported copies.

The audited first-party code has no advertising or analytics SDK integration. This does not establish that WebView, platform or hosting services collect no data. The published online policy covers an earlier release; the proposed V2 policy still requires publisher review.
